title: Toph Warden
description: very dumb joke that i thought of and had to make
body:
**_﻿"Even though I was born blind, I've never had a problem seeing. [...] I feel the vibrations in the earth. And I can see where everything is-- You, that tree, even those ants."_**

So I had a dumb idea and I spent way too long making it. No one's ever even gonna use this, so I don't know why I bothered making it at all. Still, though, you gotta admit it's kinda funny.
